notes: The Imam speaks inside the narrator's story («بَعَثَ إِلَيْنا أَبُوإِبْراهِيم ... فَجَمَعَنا»): he is the last link (owner ruling 5), kept as the bare kunya the text gives.
The dashed aside «وَاُمُّهُ مِنْ وُلْدِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبي طالِب» describes the narrator and is not a link.
